supervisor.verdict: BOUND/STRUCTURE OK: exactly the qualified native startup script dcba72de plus one prefix block.
supervisor.diff: Inserted after the nonce length check, before DL12_NATIVE_BEGIN: a comment; 'DL14_TP_BEGIN_<n> feature_writes=0 physical_input_proven=false'; 'enum_rc=0; if /usr/bin/darwin-trackpad-enum --nonce "$nonce"; then :; else enum_rc=$?; fi'; 'DL14_TP_COLLECTED_<n> rc=<raw> physical_input_proven=false'; 'case "$enum_rc" in 0|77) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac'. Everything from DL12_NATIVE_BEGIN onward (inventory gate, keyboard-node wait, mouse refusal, keyboard-only compositor, 80 s observer, closed 6-record export, TERM/wait, STATUS, footer, return) is byte-identical to dcba72de.
supervisor.properties: The collector runs once inside if/else, so a non-zero rc does not trip errexit, and the raw rc is printed before any decision. Any rc other than 0 or 77 exits 1 before the runtime directory, trap, compositor or client exist. There is no typing prompt and no input path. This is the same structure approved for the DART survey supervisor.

collector.strings: Reads PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1 at 'IOService:/IOResources' (provider) and at 'IOService:/IOResources/PDM1SPIHID' (instance). Output is nonce-bound DL14_TP_RECORD_BEGIN/HEX/END with SHA-256, DL14_TP_COPY and one DL14_TP_VERDICT carrying 'input_proven=false feature_writes=0'. The usage string is 'darwin-trackpad-enum --nonce <48 lowercase hex>'.

notes.text: The instance path is the PDM1SPIHID IOHIDDevice under IOResources. On a successful T1 start it exists with the adapter's instance copy; on a failed start only the IOResources copy remains (adapter preservation on every path). The collector's handling of an absent instance and of mismatch is Grok's source review.
